biggest_catch: Google runs student programs (Google Developer Groups on Campus and the old Google Student Ambassador lineage), but Google publishes no concrete compensation for the ambassador role on any official page.
catches: Many third-party 2026 write-ups claim a 'Google Student Ambassador' program with monthly stipends, but none of those figures come from official Google pages.
The current official program (Google Developer Groups on Campus) describes leadership/learning perks, not pay.
No payout quote or pay schedule can be produced from any official Google source.

c1.evidence: Google is real and runs student programs, but the named ambassador program has no live official pay terms.

c2.evidence: Official program pages exist (GDG on Campus lineage) but publish no compensation terms.

c3.evidence: No fee stated; not the blocking issue.

c4.evidence: No payout quote on any official Google page.

eligibility: Student-program eligibility exists in the GDG lineage, but compensation is unspecified — the role cannot be verified as a paid money route.
notes: Reject per the no-inferred-compensation rule: third-party 2026 articles assert stipends, but Google itself publishes no concrete ambassador compensation. Re-verify if Google publishes official paid terms.
